calibration.note: Body height is a chosen physical template, not a measurement of a photographed sample. Normalized coordinates use full alpha bounds height, x origin at center axis; y upward from lowest alpha pixel. For product.heightMm mapping multiply normalized coordinates by product.heightMm / 1000.

references.annotationMethod: Visual tracing of seam paths and features; external contour and bounds are exact alpha-mask measurements.
